name: Crest of Lordaeron

angles.text: As a former citizen of Lordaeron, you treasure relics of the fallen kingdom as rare remnants of your past and heritage.
You help Forsaken archivists in Undercity preserve Lordaeron’s legacy amid the ruins left by the Scourge.

faq.answer: The Crest of Lordaeron is a weathered emblem of the fallen human kingdom. Few physical relics survived the Scourge’s destruction, so it preserves a rare piece of Lordaeron’s past.
faq.q: What is the Crest of Lordaeron?

faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity receives the crest. Oran inspects and safeguards artifacts tied to the old kingdom.
faq.q: Who wants the crest in Undercity?

faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe bites the crest to test its metal and verify that it is genuine. Oran confirms it is a mostly intact relic of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Why does Oran Snakewrithe bite the crest?

aliases: why do forsaken care about lordaeron
faq.answer: The Forsaken are the undead remnants of Lordaeron’s former people. Relics of their ruined homeland remain tangible links to their history and identity.
faq.q: Why do the Forsaken value relics of Lordaeron?

faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe takes custody of the crest and keeps it safe. It helps the Forsaken preserve and remember their kingdom’s heritage.
faq.q: What will happen to the crest after it is turned in?

faq.answer: Surviving emblems and relics from before the Third War are exceptionally scarce. The Scourge’s invasion left few physical signs of Lordaeron behind.
faq.q: How rare are surviving relics from Lordaeron?

sections.body: The Third War shattered Lordaeron. Ash, ruins, and Scourge desolation swallowed much of the kingdom, leaving few emblems behind. To the Forsaken beneath the ruins of the Capital City, those that survive are precious links to the civilization they once belonged to.
sections.title: A Surviving Symbol of the Fallen Kingdom

sections.body: The weathered crest is brought from the wider world to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity. Oran tests the metal with a bite, then confirms it is genuine and mostly intact. For Oran and the Forsaken archivists, each recovered piece helps restore a history the Scourge sought to erase.
sections.title: Preserving Forsaken Heritage

summary: The Forsaken preserve what little remains of Lordaeron in Undercity. A weathered crest bears the fallen kingdom’s emblem, a rare link to its past.
attribution: In-game quest text: Crest of Lordaeron
